summary.motive: Use pre-snap Amoeba chaos to dictate offensive pass protections, then bring a timed 5-man A-gap fire pressure while dropping the mugged MIKE directly into the hot slant lane.
summary.keyDefender: WILL (weak A-gap blitzer) & MIKE (Amoeba bail linebacker)
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses check to quick hot throws against 6-up looks, but the 3-deep 3-under structure floods intermediate passing windows while 5 rushers overwhelm 5 blockers.
summary.failureMode: Quick perimeter smoke screens or max-protect 7-man deep shots that beat 3-deep zone outside the numbers.

beats.title: Amoeba Standing 6-Up Presentation
beats.text: Jesse Minter lines up 6 defenders standing across the line of scrimmage, disguising who will rush and who will drop while threatening an all-out Cover 0 blitz.

beats.title: 5-Man Fire Zone Overload & MIKE Drop
beats.text: At the snap, Minter sends 5 rushers with WILL blitzing through the weak A-gap, while MIKE bails from his A-gap mug into the strong hook zone.

beats.title: Hot Read Slant Trapped
beats.text: The QB expects Cover 0 and looks to throw his quick hot slant to Y, only to find MIKE occupying the exact throwing window with SS and Nickel bracketing the flats.

beats.title: A-Gap Overload Pressure Closes
beats.text: With the hot throw eliminated, WILL defeats the running back block and collapses the pocket for an emphatic sack.

relations.tell: Standing 6-up look where 5 rushers fire while MIKE bails to strong hook and SS buzzes down to boundary flat
